I don't recommend adding coconut milk to regular milk,/s SO what I have done is Greek and vanilla yogurt. I also made yogurt with fruit after done. To make yogurt just heat milk to 180° for about 2 minutes then cool to 115° add yogurt (Dannon-Yoplait) plane and it must have active cultures. or buy yogurt starters and let ferment for 3-6 hours @ 110° to 118°. I use a crock pot low setting. Every 30 minutes turn on for about a minute and cover with bath towel to hold in the heat. Then dump in a Colander to drain off the whey (water) for an hour in the fridge. If you like thick yogurt leave as is and if you like the store kind then add some whey back in and mix, This is when I add fruit. Also if you let the yogurt sit for 3-4 hours you can make cream cheese from it.
